Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished wide 21:9 game cutscene illustration, target 1860x845, one single borderless panel. This is a NEW scene using the attached images as identity/style references. Match their mature 1990s inked cyberpunk graphic-novel art exactly: substantial precise black linework, cross-hatching, painterly ink color, worn physical objects, amber practical lights, cyan electronics, plum night shadows. Not photographic, not CGI, not anime, not pixel art. Continuity and anatomy have priority. No dialogue, caption, UI overlay, watermark or random written signs. Only existing canonical clothing/car marks may appear. All people and physical objects must be separate with correct occlusion; natural hands with exactly five fingers, no merged fingers, no bodies through equipment. Keep the principal focal details inside the artwork because captions are rendered outside it by the game.
Scene 1: THE DELIVERY. The race has ended. At a modest transit relay receiving bay off the wet neon boulevard, Cache Back has safely delivered his original recording. Chest-up Cache occupies the right foreground, wearing exactly the attached yellow winged cap, black rectangular glasses, angular black respirator mask with thin cyan accents, black headphones resting around his neck, yellow short-sleeved wrap shirt with black Greek-key trim, and black wristwatch. Use his face and costume exactly, do not invent a different model. Cache's right hand rests safely beside a closed transparent cassette receiving tray, fully visible at lower center. Inside is the same small dark cassette cartridge from reference 1 with a horizontal worn yellow stripe, small yellow triangle and red corner tab. Keep fingers away from tray edges. Behind Cache at left, his yellow hatchback is parked in the bay, seen directly from REAR, never invent front design. Copy the reference 2 rear shape, wide tires, black stripes/Greek trim, roof rack, twin reel shapes behind back glass and central white circular emblem with the exact existing black mark. Car is at credible human scale, unobstructed enough to recognize, wheels planted, engine now still. No other identifiable characters. Background wall has a receiver cabinet, cable runs and distant road exit, grounded warm service lights and cyan relay points. Delivery feels achieved but restrained; relief, not a victory explosion. No text anywhere except exact preexisting emblem marks. Wide cinematic composition with Cache/cassette at right-center and car left background, show environment and the terminal separately.
